title: The Freedom to Remain Unfinished
seoTitle: The Freedom to Remain Unfinished | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal reflection on love, expectations and change, asking whether we can feel understood without being expected to remain the same person forever.
deck: On love, expectations, and the difficulty of understanding a person who is still becoming.

sources.name: Mir Taqi Mir — Jis sar ko ghurur aaj hai yaan taajvari ka (ghazal)
sources.context: Verified original Urdu couplet, attribution and ghazal; English rendering in the article is original.

heroAlt: Illustrated ascending steps leading through an incomplete arch towards an open sky, representing personal growth and freedom to change.
heroCaption: To understand someone is not to insist that they stop becoming.
